Class Utils

java.lang.Object
ui.utils.Utils
public class Utils extends Object
The Utils class provides a collection of utility methods for common tasks. These include reading input from the console, displaying lists, and handling user selections.

    • readLineFromConsole

      public static String readLineFromConsole(String prompt)
      Reads a line of input from the console after displaying the provided prompt.
      Parameters:
      prompt - The message to be displayed to the user before reading input
      Returns:
      The input line entered by the user, or null if an exception occurs

    • readIntegerFromConsole

      public static int readIntegerFromConsole(String prompt)
      Reads an integer value from the console after displaying the provided prompt. This method repeatedly prompts the user until a valid integer is entered. If a non-integer value is entered, an error is logged, and the user is asked to provide input again.
      Parameters:
      prompt - The message to be displayed to the user before reading input.
      Returns:
      The integer value entered by the user.

    • readDoubleFromConsole

      public static double readDoubleFromConsole(String prompt)
      Reads a double value from the console after displaying the provided prompt. This method repeatedly prompts the user until a valid double value is entered. If an invalid value is entered, an error is logged, and the user is prompted again.
      Parameters:
      prompt - The message to be displayed to the user before reading input.
      Returns:
      The double value entered by the user.

    • readDateFromConsole

      public static Date readDateFromConsole(String prompt)
      Reads a date from the console based on the format "dd-MM-yyyy" after displaying the provided prompt. This method repeatedly prompts the user until a valid date is entered. If an invalid date format is entered, an error is logged, and the user is asked to provide input again.
      Parameters:
      prompt - The message to be displayed to the user before reading the date input
      Returns:
      The date entered by the user, parsed into a Date object

    • confirm

      public static boolean confirm(String message)
      Prompts the user with a message and requests confirmation by typing "s" for yes or "n" for no. The method will keep prompting until a valid response is entered.
      Parameters:
      message - The confirmation message to display to the user.
      Returns:
      True if the user confirms with "s" (case insensitive), false otherwise.

    • showAndSelectOne

      public static Object showAndSelectOne(List list, String header)
      Displays a list of elements with a header and allows the user to select one of the elements. The method first shows the list using showList and then allows the user to select an element from the list using selectsObject. If the user selects "Cancel" (option 0), the method returns null.
      Parameters:
      list - The list of elements to display and select from.
      header - The header message to display above the list.
      Returns:
      The selected object from the list, or null if "Cancel" is chosen.

    • showAndSelectIndex

      public static int showAndSelectIndex(List list, String header)
      Displays a list of elements with a header and allows the user to select one of the elements by index. The method first shows the list using showList and then allows the user to select an index using selectsIndex. The user can also cancel the selection by choosing option 0.
      Parameters:
      list - The list of elements to display and allow selection from.
      header - The header message to display above the list.
      Returns:
      The index of the selected element (0-based), or -1 if "Cancel" is chosen.

    • showList

      public static void showList(List list, String header)
      Displays a list of elements with a header in the console. Each element in the list is displayed as a numbered item starting from 1. An option to cancel the operation is added as "0 - Cancel" at the end of the list.
      Parameters:
      list - The list of elements to be displayed. Each element's toString() method is used to generate its string representation.
      header - The header message to be displayed above the list.

    • selectsObject

      public static Object selectsObject(List list)
      Prompts the user to select an object from the given list. The list elements are indexed starting from 1, and the user can choose an object by typing its corresponding number. Option 0 allows the user to cancel, returning null.
      Parameters:
      list - The list of objects to select from. Each object in the list should have a meaningful string representation for display purposes.
      Returns:
      The selected object from the list, or null if the user cancels the operation by entering 0.

    • selectsIndex

      public static int selectsIndex(List list)
      Prompts the user to select an index from the provided list. The input is taken from the console, and the user is repeatedly asked to provide valid input until a number within the range of the list indices is entered. The returned value is 0-based, and the user can effectively cancel the operation by entering 0, resulting in a return value of -1.
      Parameters:
      list - The list of elements for which an index is to be selected.
      Returns:
      The 0-based index of the selected element, or -1 if the selection is cancelled by choosing option 0.
